P.name: League of Draven
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.
P.description2: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}.

Q.name: Spinning Axe
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' starts spinning his axe, empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
Q.description2: Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by '''Draven's''' {{tt|current movement|See notes}}. If '''Draven''' catches the axe, he gains ''Spinning Axe's'' empowered attack again.
Q.description3: '''Draven''' can hold up to two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.

W.name: Blood Rush
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' enters an adrenaline rush, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds as well as decaying {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|50 to 70}}%}}

E.name: Stand Aside
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' throws a fan of axes in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds.

R.name: Whirling Death
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.
R.description2: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
R.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110 to 150}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*2 to 150*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
R.description4: ''Whirling Death'' deals {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}} damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
R.description5: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
